title: Complete Guide to Database Sharding
title_es: Guía Completa de Sharding de Bases de Datos
description: Runnable companion for the sharding guide: a directory-based shard router, a tenant migration script, and the shard_directory schema used in the multi-tenant SaaS worked example.
description_es: Companion ejecutable de la guía de sharding: un router de shards por directorio, un script de migración de tenants y el esquema de shard_directory del ejemplo multi-tenant.
